description: This Java class defines the RetrieveThingDefinitionStrategy, a strategy for handling RetrieveThingDefinition commands in an Akka actor-based persistence context. It processes commands to retrieve the definition of a 'Thing' and produces appropriate results or errors, utilizing specific Eclipse Ditto model classes.

classes.name: RetrieveThingDefinitionStrategy
classes.description: Immutable class that extends AbstractThingCommandStrategy to handle RetrieveThingDefinition commands, extracting the ThingDefinition and producing appropriate results or errors.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Processes the command, extracting the ThingDefinition from the provided Thing, and returning a Result containing the definition or an error if inaccessible.

methods.name: extractDefinition
methods.description: Helper method that retrieves the ThingDefinition from the supplied Thing, throwing if the entity is null.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the previous entity tag associated with the successfully retrieved entity, if available.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Determines the next EntityTag based on the provided new entity, if its definition can be converted into an EntityTag.
